# Support — Squirrels

## Free theme support

The free Squirrels theme is supported through:

- **GitHub Issues** — [squirrels/issues](https://github.com/Squirrels-Ninja/squirrels/issues)
  For confirmed bugs and feature requests. Not for general WordPress help.
- **Documentation** — [treehouse.squirrels.ninja](https://treehouse.squirrels.ninja)
  Install guide, customizer reference, child theme guide, WooCommerce setup.

Before opening an issue:
1. Check the [documentation](https://treehouse.squirrels.ninja).
2. Search [existing issues](https://github.com/Squirrels-Ninja/squirrels/issues?q=is%3Aissue).
3. Confirm you are running the [latest release](https://github.com/Squirrels-Ninja/squirrels/releases/latest).

## What is supported

✅ Bugs in the theme code  
✅ Compatibility issues with WordPress core  
✅ Compatibility issues with WooCommerce  
✅ Accessibility defects  

## What is not supported

❌ General WordPress configuration questions  
❌ Third-party plugin conflicts (other than WooCommerce)  
❌ Customizations beyond the built-in Customizer settings  
❌ Hosting or server configuration  

For questions outside this scope, the [WordPress.org forums](https://wordpress.org/support/) and [WooCommerce documentation](https://woocommerce.com/documentation/) are good starting points.

## Response times (free tier)

Issues are reviewed on a best-effort basis. There is no guaranteed response time for the free theme.

## Pro support

Priority support with guaranteed response times is included with [Squirrels Workshop Pro](https://squirrels.ninja/workshop). See the [support policy](https://squirrels.ninja/support) for full details.
